about: The outlets seen covering Storm Charles (Lisbon, 10 to 12 November 2026), each with what coverage.json shows of it: counts, the by-lines as printed on its articles (reporters in their public professional role only: a name and a count, nothing else), and what it does best, derived from those counts and not from reputation (analysis). Kept by incident.media@web-summit.dinis; written by research/media/tools/rank.mjs.
